Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Two quick asks so our AP portal can accept Redwood invoices without manual intervention:

1) Supplier token: our portal requires a supplier token (SPT) to be created on our side before invoices POST successfully. Please confirm the company legal name, primary remit bank (IBAN), and EU VAT/EORI so we can generate the SPT.

2) Line-level PO mapping: we need the field layout for line-level PO linking (field names for PO number, line_number, item_code, net_amount, tax_amount). If Redwood can provide a sample JSON/XML invoice payload, our onboarding script will validate it and avoid rejects.

Also tagging this thread for early-pay opt-in details (BrightPoint offers dynamic discounting; we surface an "accept early pay" flag during supplier onboarding). If you want to enroll, we require signed bank mandate and confirmation of the discount matrix (days vs discount%).

Can you send over the docs and an example invoice to ap@brightpointhealth.com?

Regards,
Lesley
AP Operations — BrightPoint Health

Quick follow-up from procurement: BrightPoint requires two extra verification items for non-US suppliers:

• Corporate registry extract (dated within 90 days) — to validate legal entity and directors.
• VAT reverse-charge evidence: we need the contract clause or confirmation that line items are subject to reverse-charge and the supplier VAT is valid for cross-border supply.

If you can add the registry extract and a short note in the onboarding packet clarifying which invoice lines are reverse-charge eligible, procurement will expedite token issuance (we typically issue SPT within 48 hours after docs).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll sign the DocuSign envelope this afternoon and return the bank mandate. A couple of operational notes so the token activation is smooth on our side:

1) Please send the SPT and the effective activation timestamp (UTC). We'll schedule a hot-reload so our invoice middleware accepts SPT immediately at that timestamp to avoid rejects.
